Fazzio HDPE values 40/80 are weight, not sheet price. No price supplied.
Sold/ended local auctions and historical prices are not available delivered stock.
OpenATC/ImpactATC ER20 projects and CNC6040/XATC custom mechanisms are not priced, validated, directly compatible ER11 commercial kits. No automatic ATC saving is credited.
BT30/ISO30 racks require an ATC spindle and do not convert the owned standard ER11 spindle. Solo requires manual intervention and is not a multi-tool automatic replacement.
